description.value: Sidekick Brewing is a riverfront microbrewery and kitchen located along the Vedder River next to the Vedder River Bridge, directly on the Vedder Rotary Trail Loop just outside Chilliwack. Opened in Fall 2022 by a small group of friends, the brewery leans into community and experimentation, producing a rotating tap list alongside a full kitchen menu. Its location 7 minutes from Cultus Lake and adjacent to a cycling trail loop makes it a natural destination stop for touring cyclists in the Fraser Valley.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack (10 spaces) at 17m; rack (5 spaces) at 23m; rack (12 spaces) at 25m. Total: 27 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and corroborates the OSM record. The contact page explicitly states 'We have many bike stands all around our patio for your sweet two-wheeled ride,' confirming bike parking. The FAQ confirms food to go ('Can I order my food to go? Absolutely.') and growler fills. Water bottle refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, and most other amenities are not mentioned on the website, so those remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible microbrewery and kitchen sitting directly on a cycling trail loop with confirmed bike parking and takeout food — a strong candidate for the directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Contact page notes that on busy days the brewery actively encourages cyclists to ride over rather than drive, and mentions overflow parking at Vedder Park across the bridge. Growler fills are also available per the FAQ.

wow_evidence: We have many bike stands all around our patio for your sweet two-wheeled ride
